required_version.description: Minimum required version of Flexy Proxy. If the installed version of Flexy is older than the specified version, Flexy displays a message prompting the user to update it.

default_route.description: Defines the default behavior when no specific route matches.

proxy.description: The URL of the proxy to connect to by default.

deny_access.description: Whether to deny access if no routing matches.

log_level.description: The level of logging detail. Possible values are 'DEBUG', 'INFO', 'WARN', or 'ERROR'.

always_mitm.description: If true, eavesdrop all HTTPS access to get the full URL. If false, only eavesdrop HTTP access if the host name matches.

insecure_cipher_suites.description: Whether to allow insecure cipher suites for HTTPS connections. This may be necessary for compatibility with some older clients.

routes.description: Routing settings. Each route defines a URL pattern and the response to return.

url.description: The URL pattern to match. If this URL matches, the specified response will be returned.

regex.description: If true, regex can be used for URL matching.

headers.description: Additional headers to include in the request.

examples.User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 18_5 like Mac OS X)

response.description: The response to return. One of 'rewrite', 'content', or 'file' can be specified.

oneOf.description: Rewrite settings. Defines how the URL should be rewritten.

regex.description: Whether to use regex for matching the 'from' URL.

proxy.description: The URL of the proxy to use for this route. If not specified, 'default_route.proxy' will be used. To disable the proxy, specify an empty string.

connect_to.description: Overrides the request's network connection target, similarly to curl's --connect-to option. Specify only the destination in host format, such as 192.168.11.2:80. This changes only where the TCP connection is established.

content.description: The content to return as the response.

content_type.description: The MIME type of the content.

status.description: The HTTP status code to return.

file.description: The file path to return as the response.

headers.description: Additional headers to include in the response.

transform.description: The command to transform the response content.

certificate.description: The path to the SSL certificate file.

certificate_key.description: The path to the private key file corresponding to the SSL certificate.
